$comment: Process-enforcement hooks for the academic paper workflow. Commands go through scripts/hooks/run.sh (POSIX sh), which execs the Windows 'py' launcher when present and falls back to 'python3' on macOS/Linux -- one settings file for every platform (Claude Code on Windows ships with Git Bash, so 'sh' is available there). Hooks run from the project root and fail open (a hook error never blocks work).
